summary: Master industrial robotics, ROS, and PLC programming. Gain hands-on skills in kinematics and automation safety. Enroll now to lead Industry 4.0 initiatives.
lede: Robotics and automation engineering combines the design, control, and integration of automated production systems. For engineers and technicians working with industrial equipment, controls, or manufacturing, this course provides a structured approach to planning and troubleshooting automated cells. Learners practise defining cell architectures, creating PLC sequences and I/O maps, and preparing safety-validation and commissioning plans.
audienceIntro: This robotics and automation engineering course suits professionals who already work with industrial equipment, controls, manufacturing processes, or technical maintenance and need a structured foundation for integrated automation projects.
prerequisites: Working knowledge of industrial equipment, manufacturing processes, electrical controls, mechanical systems, or maintenance operations is recommended. You should be comfortable reading basic process diagrams and discussing sensors, actuators, and control panels. No programming language is required, and the exercises focus on engineering design, logic interpretation, simulation concepts, and documentation rather than production software deployment.
topics: Generative AI at work & AI copilots
